meal.title: While Loops for Repetition
meal.objective: Repeat a block of code until a condition changes

voice.script: Want to keep asking until you get a valid number? How do you force the program to repeat a prompt until the input is correct? A while loop repeats a block as long as a condition stays true. The word while introduces the loop, and loop means the code goes round again. Here’s the code that uses a while loop to validate the deposit. The program asks for a deposit amount, checks if it is a positive integer, and if not, repeats the question. Running it, the program keeps asking until you enter a positive amount, then prints the confirmed deposit. Imagine a loop as a circle that goes back to the start each time. Remember: while repeats while its condition is true. Try changing the condition to stop after three attempts.
